question: Professor, I've read your works over and over, and I'm loving it. Thank you. About Anastasia, who gave burnt daisukiyaki (done to her satisfaction?) to Julius, but does Joshua normally get treated the same as well? If he did, I'd be worried about whether he'd be able to finish eating it, though...
answer: No, Julius is about the only one outside of her family that Anastasia makes food for, and really, normally she doesn't cook anyways. Supposing that Joshua happened to be given that, he probably wouldn't be able to finish it...
